features.name: Recommendations
features.desc: AI-driven contact and company recommendations tailored to your ICP. Refreshes as your usage patterns evolve — the more you engage, the sharper the recommendations get.
features.covNote: Records we can recommend with high confidence based on your seed list and recent engagement signals.

features.name: ICP Hub
features.desc: Ideal Customer Profile matching and scoring hub. Consolidates fit signals into a single workspace and ranks accounts by likelihood-to-buy so reps work the right list first.
features.covNote: Accounts where we have enough firmographic and contact data to score against your ICP criteria.

features.name: Lookalikes
features.desc: AI-powered discovery of contacts and companies similar to your best existing customers. Returns paginated results that can be piped directly into Enrich for full data.
features.covNote: Records where similarity matching returns at least 100 high-confidence matches against your seed.

features.name: Website Visitors
features.desc: Intent signal derived from website visit activity matched to known companies in our identity graph. Surface accounts showing interest before they fill out a form.
features.covNote: Visitor-to-company resolution rate from anonymous web traffic on enrolled domains.

features.name: Predictive Scoring (TOF/MOF)
features.desc: Top-of-funnel and mid-of-funnel likelihood-to-convert scores based on historical conversion patterns from the Lusha network and your own pipeline data.
features.covNote: Records where we have enough conversion signal to assign a confident TOF or MOF score.

features.name: Scoring — Signal
features.desc: Composite score derived from real-time buying signals — headcount changes, hiring surges, news events, and more — ranking accounts by signal strength.
features.covNote: Coverage data not yet published for this feature; confirm with the data team before relying on these figures.

features.name: Buying Committee — End User
features.desc: AI-identified end users within a target account — the people who will actually use your product day to day.
features.covNote: Coverage data not yet published for this feature; confirm with the data team before relying on these figures.

features.name: Buying Committee — Decision Makers
features.desc: AI-identified decision makers within a target account — the people with budget authority or sign-off power.

features.name: Buying Committee — Potential Champion
features.desc: AI-identified potential champions within a target account — internal advocates likely to support your deal.
